(In other words, a walking Lemming can fall, dig, or switch directions.","S15":"If more than one of these conditions are satisfied, fall has higher precedence than dig, which has higher precedence than switching directions.)","S16":"// Although Lemmings can walk, fall, and dig, Lemmings aren't invulnerable.","S17":"If a Lemming falls for too long then hits the ground, it can splatter.","S18":"In particular, if a Lemming falls for more than 20 clock cycles then hits the ground, it will splatter and cease walking, falling, or digging (all 4 outputs become 0), forever (Or until the FSM gets reset).","S19":"There is no upper limit on how far a Lemming can fall before hitting the ground.","S20":"Lemmings only splatter when hitting the ground; they do not splatter in mid-air.","S21":"// Implement a Moore state machine that models this behaviour. areset is positive edge triggered asynchronous reseting the Lemming machine to walk left."}
